## Types without an Arrow formatter [esql-arrow-unsupported-types]

Convert or remove columns of these types before requesting Arrow:

* `aggregate_metric_double`
* `dense_vector`
* `exponential_histogram`
* `geohash`
* `geohex`
* `geotile`
* `histogram`
* `tdigest`
